observations: Blue painted industrial gear reducer with a cast iron body.
A yellow hexagonal output shaft is visible.
A mounting flange is attached to the side of the housing.
The unit is mounted on a blue cast iron base plate with four mounting holes.
The top of the housing has a lifting eye bolt and two adjustment bolts.
Watermark 'IFABROS INDUSTRIAL POSTED ON JIJI' is present on all photos.

claims.evidence: No rating plate or nameplate is visible in the photos.
The casting texture and mounting style in photo 0 confirm cast iron construction.
The specific type (e.g., worm, helical, or planetary) cannot be determined from external photos.

risks.risk: Internal gear wear or tooth damage
risks.proof: A video of the unit running under load or a close-up of the internal gears.
A video showing the shaft rotating smoothly and a photo of the bearings.
A clear photo of the manufacturer's nameplate.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic or unverified unit

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacturer's nameplate showing the brand, model, and horsepower rating.
Video of the unit rotating to check for smoothness and noise.
Photo of the shaft and the mounting flange to check for damage.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
